projects.title: Savoury Delight
projects.description:
Gerti Foods, a newly established company in baking industry for production of frozen products with an outstanding dedication to quality, managed to replicate well preserved family recipes that were saved for more than 200 years.

Faced with the challenge of modernizing its brand while preserving its heritage, the company needed to enhance its market presence and appeal to a broader audience.

Merging Tradition with Modernity

We created eye-catching merchandise for Gerti Foods, including apparel, vehicle branding, caps, menus, and packaging that celebrate their heritage and commitment to quali…
